question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as the one followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

OPM−KLI

YZW−UVS
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d971e67c288fac81b73c34233f48d728d98b63c6f8b0b03d1584be4b583dd19.png] 

 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -4, -4, -4.

1. BCZ–XYV

2. BCZ–WYU

3. BBX–XYV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c01bd752f76fdfc2f207ac9dde517cd91344786ec7b114b2be012fb42bf11761.png]

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
